notes.title: v0.77.0
notes.content:
Gameplay

 Templar Allow templar to store two charges of psionic storm

Bots

 Improve overseer positioning Prevent overseers from pursuing enemy overseers with spawn invincibility

Visuals

 Add faint texture to background

Fixes

 Fix bug where the effects volume setting also affected the master volume Fix inconsistency in collision damage VFX where sparks would sometimes not be produced

notes.title: v0.76.0
notes.content:
Gameplay

 Dragoon Increase overseer dash distance (0.74 m -> 0.88 m) This proportionally increases dash velocity so that more damage is dealt on collision Increase overseer dash stamina cooldown (3.0 s -> 3.2 s) Decrease stone form cooldown (12 s -> 11 s)

Visuals

 Prevent drones and player names from covering overseers when they overlap

notes.title: v0.75.0
notes.content:
Gameplay

 Dragoon Increase dash stamina cooldown (2.5 s -> 3.0 s) Decrease total drone health (121.5 -> 115.4) Stone form Add extra overseer health regeneration while in stone form (7 health per second) Increase ability cooldown (10 s -> 12 s) Fix: Regain movement control immediately on early exit from stone form

Bots

 Add logic for playing against stone form Zealot: Avoid casting siphon life when it would not hit any enemy overseers

Misc

 Remove in-game tutorial

notes.title: v0.74.0
notes.content:
Gameplay

 New class: Dragoon Based on the old version of Zealot class before the rework Intended to be good at surviving Ability: Stone form Turn you and your drones into impervious stone Immune to damage and stun, movement disabled, cannot deal collision damage Cast again to turn back early

notes.title: v0.73.0
notes.content:
Gameplay

 Zealot Change siphon life area shape to a wide cone Increase overseer terminal velocity (1.96 -> 2.00 m/s) Decrease overseer acceleration (7.00 -> 6.77 m/s^2) Phantom Make drone teleportation more generous Allow drones to be teleported if they overlap the control radius

Themes

 Split theme file into sections This is a breaking change to the theme file format Theme files will need to be rewritten

notes.title: v0.72.0
notes.content:
Gameplay

 Zealot Increase siphon life radius (0.65 -> 0.75 m) Increase overseer acceleration (6.45 -> 7.00 m/s^2) Decrease overseer terminal velocity (2.05 -> 1.96 m/s) Phantom Restrict drone teleportation and healing to drones within its control radius Reduce game world size for team deathmatch games of fewer than 16 players Reduce respawn time for small team deathmatch games (down to 5 s for 8 or fewer players)

Bots

 Adjust avoidance of siphon life for overseers and drones Tweak avoidance of psionic storm for drones

Misc

 Fix: Show the correct class ability for zealot at the bottom-left of the screen

Server

 Allow changing game modes without restarting the server The new game mode will be used for new games

notes.title: v0.70.0
notes.content:
Gameplay

 Archon class: Psi-shockwave Now stuns overseers on hit for 0.75 s Overseers only partially in the psi-shockwave on hit will be stunned for only a portion of the full duration Stun interrupts blink cast Decrease minimum cast delay (600 ms -> 500 ms) Increase travel speed (2.16 m/s -> 2.28 m/s) Increase rate of expansion (expansion half-life: 0.8 s -> 0.75 s) Phantom class: Blink Place the drones in a tighter formation during teleportation The 6-drone formation is unchanged Team Deathmatch mode Reduce respawn time (8 s -> 6 s)

Bots

 Make psi-shockwaves deter bots from pursuing enemy overseers

Fixes

 Fix random crashes during multiplayer games, probably

notes.title: v0.69.0
notes.content:
New

 Add prototype for new player class: Phantom Intended to be a close-range assassin Ability: Blink Teleport you and your drones to the target position after a brief delay Movement control is disabled during the delay Heal drones for a small amount on teleport

Misc

 Player stats: Record damage dealt to drones

notes.title: v0.68.0
notes.content:
New

 Initial implementation of Team Deathmatch game mode Available in single player mode Available in multiplayer mode if the server operator changes the “misc_gameMode” parameter from “ctf” to “tdm”

Gameplay

 Decrease drone maneouverability Decrease drone acceleration by ~5% while maintaining drone terminal velocity This partially reverts the increase in the last update Reduce minimum delay between overseer dashes (250 ms -> 225 ms)

Audio

 Adjust SFX for psi-shockwave activation

Bots

 Have templar bots attempt to psi-storm enemy overseers if it would be lethal Back off from pursuing a headbutt kill when at a disadvantage and unlikely to get the kill quickly Refine logic for avoiding drones with dash charge Stay a bit further away from psi-shockwaves to avoid getting clipped Fix a bug where bots would sometimes not cast psi-storm defensively for allies if they were not templar class Fix a bug where bots would sometimes hold a drone dash charge forever if they were targeting you and you didn’t move enough

Misc

 Allow class selection at the start of new rounds

notes.title: v0.67.0
notes.content:
Gameplay

 Increase drone maneouverability Increase drone acceleration by ~10% while maintaining drone terminal velocity Archon class Increase psi-shockwave damage (24 -> 28) Decrease psi-shockwave minimum cast delay (650 ms -> 600 ms)

Audio

 Add SFX for psi-shockwave activation

Misc

 More game logic optimizations 14% less CPU usage

notes.title: v0.66.0
notes.content:
Gameplay

  Archon class Increase drone count (8 -> 9) Note: Total drone health remains the same Increase drone dash efficiency (0.55 -> 0.65)
Bots

 Refine target selection for drone movement Refine overseer movement

Misc

 Game logic optimizations 7% less CPU usage

notes.title: v0.65.0
notes.content:
Gameplay

 Archon class Decrease drone count (9 -> 8) Decrease total drone health (151.9 -> 133.7) Psi-shockwave Increase travel speed (1.80 m/s -> 2.16 m/s) Reduce minimum activation delay (0.75 s -> 0.65 s) Increase rate of expansion (expansion half-life: 1.0 s -> 0.8 s) Decrease damage (32 -> 24) Decrease lifetime (2.5 s -> 2.0 s)

Bots

 Make low-level bots better at avoiding psi-shockwaves Refine bot logic for overseer headbutts Bots are now generally more aggressive with their overseers

Misc

 Change Archon drone shape to hexagonal

notes.title: v0.64.0
notes.content:
Gameplay

 Add a prototype for a new player class: Archon Simple VFX and no SFX for prototype Intended to be good at holding positions but reliant on positioning or teammates to stay alive Ability: Psionic shockwave Launch an expanding circular area from the Archon’s overseer Use the ability again to activate the area and deal high damage to ALL overseers in the area Has a minimum range (cannot be activated for a duration after launching)

Misc

 Add a new “automatic-alt” option for drone control Drones follow the cursor when holding no mouse buttons Drones repel when holding the right mouse button

notes.title: v0.63.0
notes.content:
Misc

 Add support for assigning mouse buttons in custom keybindings Add visual themes for protanopia and deuteranopia (color blindness)

notes.title: v0.62.0
notes.content:
Audio

 Add notification SFX for psi-storm cooldown completion Remove chanting vocoder music layer Remove “enable vocoder tracks” audio option

notes.title: v0.61.0
notes.content:
Visuals

 Use body shape to indicate the classes of overseers and drones No longer use body shape to indicate the teams of overseers and drones Give zealot class a different fin shape Enlarge and brighten overseer fins to help with class identification

Themes

 Add color options for: Game: shield powerup spawners HUD: ability cooldown bar, stamina bar, drone control radius UI: flag and overseer score icons, UI text and text shadows Minimap: overseers, flags, team bases, team spawns, shield powerup spawners, flag steal notification pulses, visible/fog areas

notes.title: v0.60.0
notes.content:
UI

 Reword flag notifications to read more easily Prefix bot names with a ‘#’ (again) Split audiovisual settings into audio settings and visual settings Previously specified audiovisual settings will be forgotten and will need to be reinputted

Themes

 Add keybinding (Ctrl+R) for reloading custom themes Add color options for shield powerups, overseer shields, and dash VFX Add help screen explaining how to use themes (hold F5) Persisting limitations Theme parameters for HUD and UI elements have yet to be implemented

Music

 Add audio setting for silencing vocoder music layers The voice layers that play when flags are away from their bases

Misc

 Fix: The client now more reliably saves your settings changes on exiting

notes.title: v0.59.1
notes.content:
Misc

 Add initial support for themes Added theme parameters for most game visuals On startup, the client now looks in the same directory for pixelpusher-theme.toml and reads if it exists If pixelpusher-theme.toml doesn’t exist, it creates it and writes the default theme to it Added a new audiovisual option, “visual theme”, that allows in-game switching between the default theme and a custom theme (the one read from pixelpusher-theme.toml) Limitations Theme parameters for HUD and UI elements, as well as some game visuals, have yet to be implemented Reading updates to pixelpusher-theme.toml currently requires restarting the client

notes.title: v0.59.0
notes.content:
Gameplay

 Zealot: Decrease time needed for full overseer health regeneration (12s -> 10.5s)

Bots

 Adjust difficulty progression of bot levels Reduce difficulty of lower bot levels Enable techniques at lower bot levels (all techniques now enabled at bot level 4, previously level 8) Remove bot level 10

Misc

 Add numbers to bot names in order to make them distinguishable Use proper units in the presentation of overseer class stats

notes.title: v0.58.0
notes.content:
Gameplay

 Increase drone dash charge efficiency (0.45 -> 0.55)

Controls

 Prevent accidentally dashing twice when holding down the overseer dash key The overseer dash key must now be released before the next dash can be triggered

UI

 Simplify end-game leaderboard

Misc

 Grant assists for damage to overseers within 4 seconds of their death Reduce the stuttering that somtimes occurs at the beginning of multiplayer games

notes.title: v0.57.0
notes.content:
Gameplay

 Templar: Reduce psi-storm cooldown (10s -> 7s) Zealot: Reduce range (250 -> 200)

UI

 Make it more difficult to accidentally select a class during respawn Show personal kill notifications Enlarge drone respawn indicators Rename “custom multiplayer” menu entry to “private multiplayer”

notes.title: v0.56.0
notes.content:
Gameplay

 Add second overseer class: zealot, a simple class Strengths: Faster overseer and drones, stronger overseer dash, more overseer health Weaknesses: no psi-storm, shorter range, lower maneuverability of overseer and drones

Tutorialization

 Add help screen comparing overseer class parameters

Bots

 Improve bot behavior when carrying the flag by taking into account the flag’s slowing effect

notes.title: v0.55.0
notes.content:
Gameplay

 Reduce psi-storm duration (3 seconds -> 2.33 seconds)

Control

 Add controller support as an alternative to keyboard controls Mouse still required to play, but now you can use controller+mouse instead of keyboard+mouse Controller controls Move overseer: Left or right stick Dash overseer: Left or right bumper + left or right stick Cast psi-storm: Left or right trigger Controllers supported via the controller mapping database at https://github.com/mdqinc/SDL_GameControllerDB

UI

 Fix team names in flag notifications Tweak spacing between dash charge indicators

Visuals

 Tweak overseer visual to better delinate its “fins”

notes.title: v0.54.1
notes.content:
Gameplay

 Allow overseers to store two dash charges

Visuals

 Add 3 extra color variants per team Increase salience of dash VFX Reduce visibility of weak dashes Darken color of orphaned drones

UI

 Redesign cooldown indicators for psi-storm and overseer dash Enlarge minimap Enlarge icons Fade out notifications Simplify flag notifications

Misc

 Remove warning for leaving drones behind

notes.title: v0.53.0
notes.content:
Bots
Cast psi-storm defensively on alliesSlightly improve overseer movementTry to make bot difficult progression more similar to human skillprogression
Audio
Adjust vocorder music layers (for when allied or enemy flags are notat base)Make flag score SFX a bit larger
Misc
Support IPv6Reduce CPU usage of game logic by 20%

notes.title: v0.52.0
notes.content:
Bots

 Overseer movement Significantly improve overseer movement Fix issue where low-level bots would endlessly circle around flags and other small targets Drone movement Add latency to drone movements Better position drones to block enemy drones when defending self and allied overseers Ignore psi-storms when pursuing enemy overseers with healthy drones Overseer dash Be more careful when trying to headbutt enemy overseers with overseer dash

notes.title: v0.51.0
notes.content:
Bots

 Overseer dash Replace placeholder overseer dash logic with a proper implementation Drone repel Use drone repel to attack a target when using drone attract isn’t feasible Overseer movement Don’t maintain spacing from allies during significant advantage or disadvantage Avoid being too close to the game world boundary Avoid pursuing enemies that are already being pursued by multiple allies Avoid escorting the flag carrier if they are not threatened Be less willing to pick up enemy flags further from home base when threatened Fix a bug where overseers would approach but fail to move into a flag or flag recovery area

notes.title: v0.50.0
notes.content:
Bots

 Drone movement Acquire and pursue overseer targets more decisively Sometimes defend self and allied overseers when pressured Improve maneuvering of drones around psionic storms Charge drone dash if drones are already at the desired position Psionic storm Cast psionic storm more accurately and decisively Fix bug in psionic storm casting conditions that prevented casting psionic storm even under high pressure Overseer movement Maintain more spacing from allied overseers Try more aggressively to headbutt weaker enemy overseers Improve opportunistic gathering of shield powerups Seek shield powerups at the mid-map shield powerup spawners Improve decision making around when to pick up and drop flags When carrying the flag, be more avoidant of enemies When carrying the flag, be more aggressive during periods of team advantage Steal flags from the enemy base more opportunistically Fix a bug where overseers would sometimes would not try to reclaim a dropped allied flag Fix a bug where two allied overseers would get stuck both trying to pick up the same flag Fix a bug where an overseer would get stuck trying to pick up an shield powerup at the cusp between two obstacles

Misc

 Move team spawn areas from the bottom-left and top-right of the map to the top-left and bottom-right, respectively

notes.title: v0.49.0
notes.content:
Balance

 Mid-map shield powerups Scale shields bestowed with number of players Increase shields bestowed: 0.25 -> 0.5 (16-player game)

Visuals

 Add background effect for flag captures Show the location of team spawn locations and mid-map powerup spawners on the minimap Refinements Make psi-storm cooldown completion indicator more visible

Misc

 Synchronize the appearance of the end-game leaderboard with the end-game audio stinger

Server -- https://aetup.itch.io/pixelpusher-server

 Make it easier to run a server Automatically create and use configuration files at startup Show documentation for console commands on startup Rename, prune, and reorganize server parameters and commands for clarity Change default bot parameters to be more suitable for new players

notes.title: v0.48.0
notes.content:
Balance

 Increase drone dash efficiency (0.35 -> 0.45) To compensate for a previous decrease in drone top speed

Bots

 Add minor variation to target drone position

Visuals

 Add option for viewing team colors absolutely or relatively Absolute: color left team reddish, right team blueish Relative: color allies blueish, enemies reddish View team colors absolutely by default Color your own entities as gold when on team red (instead of teal on team blue) Flash flags carried by overseers when picking up or dropping flags Slightly increase size of minimap

UI / Controls

 Automatically attract drones to the mouse cursor by default To help out newbies Also rename “invert left mouse button” client option to “drone control” Enable setting drone control options from in-game By splitting out drone control options from custom keybindings Remember and restore navigation positions for some menus Hide mouse cursor in menus

Tutorialization

 Show a “loading screen” at the start of each game To show newbies the team colors Add a tip about charging drone dash to avoid flying your own drones into your own psionic storms Disable in-game tutorial in multiplayer games Adjust in-game tutorial and full tutorial

Other

 Minor optimizations
